name: Skibid Obby (New)
desc:
Welcome to the Easy Obby! Run, jump, and slide through this awesome obby! Be sure to like 👍 and favorite ⭐ if you enjoyed the game! 

Welcome to Skibid Obby, the latest and most thrilling obstacle course adventure on the platform! Prepare yourself for an exhilarating journey through a series of uniquely challenging and creatively designed levels. Each stage in Skibid Obby tests your agility, timing, and puzzle-solving skills.
